title: Uniform inner product
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$ and real-valued functions $f,g$ on $\Omega$, their uniform inner product is $\langle f,g\rangle_u=\frac{1}{|\Omega|}\sum_{x\in\Omega}f(x)g(x)$.
